adjudication.rationale: In `addGuests.handler.ts`, blacklist entries are normalized to lowercase (`BLACKLISTED_GUEST_EMAILS.split(...).map(email => email.toLowerCase())`), but the incoming `guest` values are compared without lowercasing (`!blacklistedGuestEmails.includes(guest)`). Likewise, dedupe against existing attendees is case-sensitive (`guest === attendee.email`). This allows bypassing both checks by changing email casing (e.g. `Bad@Example.com` vs `bad@example.com`), potentially inserting duplicate attendee rows and admitting blacklisted addresses.
